info.title: Accounting API
info.description: Accounting API for the first-party SPA and third-party systems. Contract: .docs/API-CONTRACT.md.

get.summary:
Accounts of the company, ordered by code unless `sort` says otherwise. Filters: `filter[class]`,
`filter[status]`, `filter[parent_id]` and `filter[search]` (code prefix or part of the name).
`per_page` defaults to 50, at most 200

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary:
Adds an account. The saldo normal defaults to that of the class; the parent must be active and
of the same class

patch.summary: Changes code, name, saldo normal or parent. `lock_version` is required; the class cannot change

post.summary: Deactivates the account. Refused while it has active children
Reactivates the account. Refused while its parent is inactive

get.summary: Chart of accounts templates the company can review. A template is only a suggestion

Every account of a template with its class, saldo normal, parent and whether it is optional,
for review before the import is confirmed

post.summary:
Creates the accounts of a template in an empty chart. `confirmed` must be true: the template
is only a suggestion until the company confirms it. Optional leaf accounts can be left out
with `exclude`

patch.summary:
Changes the profile. `lock_version` is required; the functional currency can only change while
the company is in `setup`

post.summary: Makes the company inactive: its data becomes read-only
Brings an inactive company back to `active`

Activates the company (`setup` to `active`). Answers 422 `COMPANY_NOT_READY` with the missing
prerequisites in `errors` when the chart of accounts, calendar or other setup is incomplete

get.summary:
The signed-in user. Answers 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED` when there is no session, which is how the
SPA learns that it must show the login screen
Workspaces the signed-in user can access right now: active, unexpired memberships only

post.summary: Creates a workspace together with its company (status `setup`); the caller becomes its first member

sessionCookie.description: First-party SPA: session cookie from the login flow, plus the XSRF-TOKEN cookie echoed in the X-XSRF-TOKEN header on writes.
sessionCookie.name: accounting_session

bearerAuth.description: Integration clients: OAuth 2.0 client-credentials access token. Treat it as opaque. Writes require an Idempotency-Key header.

AccountClass.description: The five classes of the chart of accounts. A parent and its children share one class (GL-FR-01).
AccountClass.title: AccountClass

normal_balance.description: Defaults to the normal balance of the class; the opposite is allowed for contra accounts.

functional_currency.description: Checked against the currency reference data once it exists (M2-03).
Only while the company is in setup (MD-AC-05); checked against currency reference data in M2-03.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
